messages.subject: Shinyapp works locally, but not when deployed to shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi.  I'm having trouble with my shinyapp when deployed to shinyapps.io.  You can find the app at https://karenblakemore.shinyapps.io/arules-shinyapp/.   

It works great, locally, but not on shinyapps.io.  You should be able to click on the 'Load Data Set' button and immediately see a bar chart under the 'ItemFreq' tab.  Instead, the bar chart is only shown after several clicks of the tabs along the top, then clicking 'ItemFreq'.  It seems like this is a timing issue, where click events are being missed.

Once the data set is loaded, the user should be able to change the info along the left hand side, then click the 'Generate Association Rules' button.  Then, click on one of the tabs along the top, say 'Scatter', which will pop-up a new tab with an interactive scatter plot.

There was one warning during the deployment.  Perhaps this is related to the failure:

Application successfully deployed to https://karenblakemore.shinyapps.io/arules-shinyapp/

Warning message:

In doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler) :

  unable to load shared object '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/modules//R_X11.so':

  dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/modules//R_X11.so, 6): Library not loaded: /opt/X11/lib/libSM.6.dylib

  Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/modules//R_X11.so

  Reason: image not found


Here is the ui.R file:

library(shiny)

vars <- 5
supp <- 0.1
conf <- 0.5

      }

      for(i in 1:length(input$colsRHS)){
        tmp <- with(ds, paste(input$colsRHS[i], '=', levels(as.factor(get(input$colsRHS[i]))), sep=''))

      }

    } else {
      ar <- arAll
    }

    # Rule length
    nR <- ifelse(input$samp == 'All Rules', length(ar), input$nrule)
    ar <- sort(ar, by=input$sort)[1:nR]
  })

    plot(rules(), method='graph', engine='htmlwidget')
  }, height=800, width=800)

  }, height=800, width=800)
